source: There will be a temporary change to the arrangements for receiving deliveries at the mill on Thursday. The loading bay at the rear of the building will be closed until 11:40 am. Before that time, drivers with parcels weighing no more than 12 kg should take them to the desk at the front entrance. Drivers with heavier parcels must call the warehouse supervisor and wait in their vehicle for instructions. After the loading bay opens, all drivers should use it as usual. The change applies to Thursday only. There is no need for the person expecting a parcel to contact the warehouse or to meet the driver outside.

source: At the end of a short trial, the workshop has received readings from a pair of electricity meters. On Monday, meter A recorded 18 kWh and meter B recorded 21 kWh. On Tuesday, meter A recorded 16 kWh. No Tuesday reading was obtained from meter B because the display was blank when the technician visited. A blank display should be entered as missing in the trial report. It is not evidence that the machine used zero electricity. The technician is due to revisit meter B on Friday. Until that visit, the workshop cannot use these figures to compare total electricity consumption across the two days.

source: The hall has announced what ticket holders should do if the afternoon performance on 4 May is cancelled. A ticket holder who paid by card can request a refund by emailing the box office within ten working days of the cancellation. Cash customers must bring their original ticket to the box office in person. The hall has not announced a deadline for cash customers. Neither group will receive a refund automatically. At present the performance is still scheduled to take place. This information is being circulated in advance so that people can keep the relevant documents, and it should not be treated as a notice that the event has been cancelled.
